newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt nurse suspected of killing seven patients.
newsitem.headline: Egypt nurse suspected of killing seven patients.

text.p: Prosecutors have ordered an Egyptian nurse held in custody for 45 days pending an investigation into the deaths of seven patients in Alexandria, security sources said on Sunday.
They said the order was issued on Saturday after Aida Noreddin Abu Zeid, 32, was alleged to have told interrogators she gave the victims a chemical that caused respiratory failure.
Abu Zeid was reported to have claimed responsibility for the deaths over a period of a year and of giving the same substance to 22 others she was treating, the sources said.
The nurse gave prosecutors two explanations, the sources said.
They said she told interrogators she killed her patients in order to blame the deaths on the doctor in charge at the hospital's intensive care unit because he had ended an affair with her.
In another version, she said she did not want to kill the patients but only create problems she could then solve so that she could prove her efficiency.
